metadata.description: Marketplace for canopy: an open-source architecture + delivery cockpit for software architects, driven from a web dashboard or from Claude.

plugins.name: canopy
plugins.description: Manage software architecture, projects, milestones, teams, Jira sync, and Gantt scheduling from Claude — with review-first change proposals: stage updates from any connected source (Slack, email, meetings, Jira, GitHub, Drive) for the architect to review and commit in the canopy UI.
